name: Language Detector API
plain: Guesses the language of text on the device.

access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

chrome.note: Availability may be subject to geographical restrictions.

data.metric: Guesses the language of text on the device.

limits.headline: Can guess the language of text on your device, without sending it away
limits.user_action: You tap a button like Translate this page or Detect language
can: Guess the language of a text snippet with a confidence score
Choose the right language before translating
Download the small model the first time
cannot: Start without a click or tap on the page
Send the text to a server for this check
Work in Firefox, Safari or on Chrome for Android
Be sure with very short or mixed language text
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge on computers only.

story.what_it_is: A page can guess which language a piece of text is written in, without sending it away.

marketing.name: Language Detector API
marketing.pitch: Detects the language of text on the device, so sites can offer the right translation without a cloud call.

story.for_you: You do not see it. The site may offer to translate a message or page because it spotted another language. It works without sending your text to a server.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to route text to the right translator, show the right keyboard or tag content. Doing it on device saves cost and keeps text private. The small model may need a download first.

use_cases.example: A social site spots a post in Spanish and shows a Translate button for an English reader.
A web chat detects a friend's message language and offers a translation.
A browser game chat guesses the language of players and routes them to the right room.
A store marks reviews by language so you can filter to those you can read.
A news reader picks the right text to speech voice for each article.
A learning site checks that an answer is in the right language for the lesson.
A moderation tool detects language before checking a post against the right rules.
